prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.7%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 32.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Tray Launcher Onboarding: Add an interactive tray control practice screen at the end of onboarding where users practice hiding, revealing, and controlling their desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling or hiding pets post-setup, and finish completion drops to 73.5%.)
1: [choose_path, new_flow] Personality Quiz Path Selection Flow: Introduce a 2-question personality recommendation quiz right before choosing a path to match users with preset pets or custom creation. (why: Users take an average of 514s on choose_path with a dropoff of 19.3%, showing hesitation during initial path selection.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Waiting Cloud Account Sync Placement: Reorder sign-in to take place immediately before background rendering so cloud account binding happens prior to local desktop setup. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in later, pointing to account sync timing issues.)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Screen Position Hotkey Callout: Add a prominent key combination hint on the final screen explaining how to immediately summon or hide the pet on desktop. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding or summoning lost desktop pets.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Audio Cue Sound Effect: Trigger an audio sound effect cue when background pet rendering completes on the waiting screen. (why: Users wait a median of 201s (mean 2336s) on the waiting screen and often tab away from the app.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Intro Screen Layout: Convert the intro story screen into a vertical story scroll layout showing lively pet animations before users pick a path. (why: choose_path step drops 19.3% of users and has an extreme 514s mean time, showing users lack initial visual context.)

scores.note: Interactive screen directly addresses finish step drop-off and support confusion, but requires a new screen.
Adding a personality quiz flow targets high mean time on choose_path, though it lacks direct support mail evidence.
Strongly supported by 8 support emails regarding cloud sync issues; reordering flow is moderate effort.
High ROI change adding a hotkey callout to reduce finish drop-off with minimal config/text effort.
Audio cue targets massive wait time on home step where users tab away during background rendering.
Story scroll redesign helps user hesitation on choose_path, backed primarily by funnel timing data.
